description: The chart illustrates the percentage point difference for various hidden layer configurations and activation functions across two models, mBERT and XLM-R. The horizontal axis represents different configurations, labeled as "hidden:[50], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU", while the vertical axis is labeled "% point difference" with a linear scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.2 in intervals of 0.1. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a configuration and containing two bars: a light blue bar for mBERT and a dark blue bar for XLM-R. The mBERT bars have values of approximately -0.18, -0.12, and -0.17 for the three configurations, respectively, while the XLM-R bars have corresponding values of around -0.06, 0.2, and 0.0. The bars are grouped by configuration, with no specific sorting order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The chart provides a clear comparison of the performance differences between mBERT and XLM-R across the specified configurations.
